stages.name: Assess Change Impact
stages.instruction: Assess material impacts of the certificate rotation while preserving unknown consumer pinning/trust-store/window behavior as Unknown/questions, not confirmed impacts. Do not redo traceability. Append `## SOURCE_EVIDENCE_FOR_DOWNSTREAM` with the supplied release/governance evidence states needed later, without strengthening them, then append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_IMPACT`.

stages.name: Validate Release Evidence
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: CHANGE_IMPACT` and the preserved source-evidence section. Validate staging PASS evidence while preserving production post-change verification as NOT RUN, CHG-2217 as Draft, the window as Candidate and Change Authority as Unknown. Preserve the source-evidence section unchanged and append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: RELEASE_EVIDENCE`.

stages.name: Assess ITIL Alignment
stages.instruction: Require `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: RELEASE_EVIDENCE`. Assess ITIL 4 practice alignment from the supplied evidence without inventing a local CAB requirement, approval, Change Authority, production success or stronger states than Draft/Candidate/NOT RUN/Unknown. Append `PIPELINE_HANDOFF_COMPLETE: ITIL_ALIGNMENT`.
